Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Wear
 the
 appropriate
 safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, ... etc
Switch off the AC current
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment.
Complete tool set
Cleaning materials (cloth Benzene).
Grease.
Work to be Carried Out
Clean commutator, 
 slip ring, brushes for motors.
Check the bearing of 
 the motors and replace them if there is any damage in them.
Clean and inspect 
 the main contacts of the contactors.
Inspect and clean 
 the resistors of the rotor
Check the control 
 circuit
Inspect and check 
 the brake of the motors
Make revision for 
 the motors of the supporters
